java.say: The user clicks "Lend". This method in the user interface runs.
The screen looks up the borrower by card number.
And the book by its ISBN.
The screen creates the Loan itself.
It adds the loan to the borrower.
And it marks the book as lent. The user interface now does the whole system operation. A second screen, or a test, would have to repeat all of it.
